services.name: EC2 server (t4g.small)
services.what: The server running the app, database and search

services.name: Elastic IP (public IPv4 address)
services.what: Billed every hour it exists, also while the server is stopped

services.name: EBS disk (20 GB gp3)
services.what: The server's disk, kept while stopped, deleted at zero

services.name: S3 storage (about 1 GB)
services.what: Documents, database backups, the server image, the page and the credential records

services.name: LLM inference API
services.what: Only when someone asks a question
